title: Invite Tracker Update
summary: Astrix now shows which member invited someone to the server whenever Discord provides invite tracking data.
items: `/invites view` — view invite totals and who invited a member.
`/invites inviter` — view a member's inviter, invite code, and join time.
`/invites recent` — view recent joins together with their inviters.
`/invites stats` — view the server's invite activity summary.
`/settings news-channel` — choose the channel used for Astrix update announcements.
